name: The Platinum Card from American Express

loungeAccess.network: Amex Global Lounge Collection (1,550+ lounges in 140 countries)
otherLounges: American Express Centurion Lounges (15 US locations)
Delta Sky Club (limited to 10 visits/year when flying Delta)
loungeAccess.notes: Centurion Lounges: up to 2 guests at $50/guest. Priority Pass: enrollment required, guest policy varies by lounge. Delta Sky Club: limited to 10 complimentary visits per year as of Feb 2024; must be flying on Delta-marketed/operated flight. Note: Amex Platinum still has Priority Pass Select as of 2026 (not removed).

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $20,000 every 12 months across all claims.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip. Delayed baggage is NOT covered — only lost/stolen/damaged.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the personal Amex Platinum. Rental car coverage includes up to $300,000 accidental death/dismemberment as part of that benefit.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist: 24/7 hotline for emergency medical evacuation (no cost to cardholder for evacuation transport), repatriation of mortal remains, and care for unattended minor children. Does NOT cover medical treatment costs — only coordinates and covers the transport itself.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Up to 30 consecutive days.

airlineCredit.notes: $200 annual airline fee credit for one selected qualifying airline. Covers incidental fees (baggage fees, seat upgrades, etc.) — NOT airfare.

hotelCredit.notes: $200 annual hotel credit for prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection bookings through Amex Travel (minimum 2-night stay for The Hotel Collection).

uberCredit.notes: $15/month Uber Cash credit ($35 in December) for US Uber rides and Uber Eats. Must add card to Uber app.

otherCredits.name: CLEAR Plus Credit
otherCredits.notes: Covers annual CLEAR+ membership for expedited airport security.

otherCredits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
otherCredits.notes: $20/month for eligible streaming/digital services (Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, Peacock, NYT, etc.).

otherCredits.name: Saks Fifth Avenue Credit
otherCredits.notes: $50 Jan-Jun + $50 Jul-Dec at Saks Fifth Avenue.

rewards.travelRate: 5x on flights booked directly with airlines or through Amex Travel (up to $500,000/year); 5x on prepaid hotels through Amex Travel

pointValue.transferPartners: varies (often 0.015-0.02+ with airline partners like Air Canada Aeroplan, ANA, Delta SkyMiles, etc.)

travelPerks: Amex Centurion Lounge access (15 US + international locations)
Priority Pass Select membership (1,200+ global lounges)
Delta Sky Club access up to 10 visits/year when flying Delta
$200 annual hotel credit (Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection)
Secondary rental car insurance up to $75,000
Trip delay coverage after 6 hours ($500/trip, 2 claims/year)
Premium Global Assist — emergency evacuation coordination at no charge
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
1:1 point transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Premium travelers who maximize lounge access, hotel perks, and multiple annual credits to offset the high fee
